title: EthicApp Domain Event Envelope
description: Envelope for one-way domain events published by an EthicApp service on the application Redis pub/sub channel ethicapp:events:<type>.

type.description: Kebab-case event name. Also selects the channel ethicapp:events:<type>.

version.description: Payload contract version for this event type.

id.description: Unique event identifier, used for deduplication and log correlation.

occurredAt.description: Time the publisher recorded the event.

source.description: Kebab-case name of the publishing service.

payload.description: Event-specific data defined by the schema for type and version. Must not contain personal data.
